lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with New York City businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. New York is the most crowded market in the United States for almost any product or service, and customers have alternatives within a few minutes' walk. We help businesses choose a narrow, winnable position, by neighbourhood, by speciality or by language, and build their marketing around it.

sections.heading: A walking city searches differently
paragraphs: Most of the country chooses businesses by driving distance. New Yorkers choose by blocks and subway stops. A search for a pharmacy, a barber or a slice is made on the pavement, and the result that wins is close, open now and well reviewed. People name their neighbourhood when they search: Astoria, Park Slope, Washington Heights, the Upper West Side, Bushwick. Borough matters too, and a business in Queens gains little from ranking in Lower Manhattan.

This puts unusual weight on the details of local search. Hours must be right, including holidays. Photos should show the storefront so people can spot it from the street. Reviews need to keep arriving, and the website should mention nearby landmarks, cross streets and train lines in a natural way. Restaurants also have to manage their listings on the delivery and reservation platforms that New Yorkers use daily.

sections.heading: Industries that set the pace
paragraphs: Finance, law, media, advertising, fashion, real estate, healthcare and technology are all concentrated in New York, each with a dense layer of specialist firms selling to the others. For a boutique law practice, a fintech startup or a design studio, the buyer is sophisticated and has been pitched many times. Generic claims are ignored. What works is evidence: clear writing about a particular problem, named expertise, and content that ranks for the precise questions clients ask.

Consumer businesses face a parallel challenge. Advertising costs are high because so many companies bid for the same audience, so every click has to land on a page built to convert it. We pair ad management with landing pages made by our own developers and creative made to be tested, and we report results in revenue terms.
bullets: Neighbourhood-level keyword research and location pages for each site you operate.
Ad targeting by zip code and radius, tightened to where customers really come from.
Landing pages with one clear action, tested against alternatives.
Short-form video and photography for Instagram and TikTok, where restaurants, shops and studios are found.
Content for professional firms that shows depth in a named speciality.

sections.heading: A city of many languages and constant visitors
paragraphs: New York is one of the most linguistically varied cities on earth. Spanish is spoken throughout the five boroughs, and there are large Chinese-speaking communities in Flushing, Sunset Park and Manhattan's Chinatown, Russian speakers in southern Brooklyn, Bengali, Korean, Haitian Creole, Arabic and French speakers, and many more. For clinics, lawyers, accountants and retailers in these neighbourhoods, marketing in the community's language is often the main route to customers. TDM works in English, French and Arabic, and we will tell you directly which other languages we can and cannot support.

Tourism adds another layer. Visitors fill Midtown, Lower Manhattan and parts of Brooklyn all year, with a marked peak around the winter holidays, while many residents leave town on summer weekends. Fashion weeks, major trade shows and the theatre season each move demand in particular trades. A sound plan sets budgets by these cycles instead of spending evenly.

faqs.q: Does TDM have an office in New York City?
faqs.a: No. We work with New York businesses remotely. You deal with the people doing the work, by video call and in shared documents.

faqs.q: How do I rank on Google Maps in my NYC neighbourhood?
faqs.a: Keep your business profile complete and accurate, choose the right categories, add real photos, and ask customers for reviews consistently. Your website should support it with a page that describes your location, neighbourhood and services clearly.

faqs.q: Is paid advertising worth it in New York given the cost?
faqs.a: It can be, if targeting is narrow and the landing page converts. Broad campaigns across the whole city burn money. Campaigns limited to the right zip codes, search terms and hours tend to return far more per dollar.

faqs.q: Should I market to one borough or the whole city?
faqs.a: Start where your customers already come from. A storefront usually draws from a small radius. Professional and online businesses can reach wider, but they still do better when they lead with a clear speciality.

faqs.q: How much does digital marketing cost in NYC?
faqs.a: The cost depends on scope and competition in your category. We hold a free consultation first and then send a quote for the work agreed.
